name: Element with lang attribute has valid language tag

cases.title: Passed Example 1
cases.html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
	<body>
		<article lang="en">
			They wandered into a strange Tiki bar on the edge of the small beach town.
		</article>
	</body>
</html>
